'''Leclerc''' is an NPC in the [[The Black Shores]] who appears in [[Haven of Sprouts]] and [[Tethys Hub]]. She is a cognitive behaviorist studying the [[Tethys System]] robots.

==Quests and Events==
{{Quests and Events|Leclerc}}

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(In Tethys Hub during the day)
:'''KU-Pika:''' Ms. Leclerc, could you check when KU-Join's maintenance will be finished?
:'''Leclerc:''' Hmm, you've been asking about KU-Join a lot lately. Missing it? Don't worry, I'll find out for you.
:'''KU-Miki:''' Ms. Leclerc, help! Adrian says he's upgrading me tomorrow! Last time he did that, I lost a whole year's worth of memory!
:'''Leclerc:''' Ugh, that man! Always doing whatever he feels like... Don't worry, I'll talk to him for you.
:'''KU-Tay:''' Ms Leclerc, KU-Leto and KU-Svan are fighting.
:'''Leclerc:''' Those two? Really? I'll go check on them in a bit.
:'''Leclerc:''' Oh, hello there. Sorry, I didn't see you.
:{{DIcon}} You're really popular.
:'''KU-Miki:''' Ms. Leclerc is our best friend!
:'''KU-Pika:''' Definitely!
:'''KU-Tay:''' Absolutely!
:'''Leclerc:''' Haha, I'm honored.
:'''Leclerc:''' I'm a cognitive behaviorist, and I've been studying the Tethys System robots. Maybe they trust me because I talk to them a lot.
:{{DIcon}} So, you study how they think and behave?
:'''Leclerc:''' Yes. Their personalities were originally assigned by the Tethys System to help with tasks.
:'''Leclerc:''' But now, they're expressing themselves, with their own thoughts and worries.
:'''Leclerc:''' I believe with some guidance and education, their logic program can evolve and form more developed identities.
:'''Leclerc:''' Just look at them— they've already gone beyond what the system initially gave them. It's a different kind of life, but it's still life, isn't it?
:{{DIcon}} Sounds interesting.
::'''Leclerc:''' You should try talking to the robots more. Perhaps you'll even make friends with one of them.
:{{DIcon}} Sounds risky.
::'''Leclerc:''' I get your concern, but I think instead of curbing it, we should find ways to adapt and move forward.
----
;(In Haven of Sprouts at night)
:'''Leclerc:''' [[Adrian]], are you planning to upgrade KU-Miki?
:'''Adrian:''' Yeah, its system's been acting up since the last update. I think the new component isn't compatible, so I need to make some adjustments.
:'''Leclerc:''' But you can't just change things like that. The last time you upgraded KU-Miki, it lost a whole year of memories!
:'''Adrian:'''That was a temporary side effect--things like discomfort, memory loss, or cognitive issues can happen sometimes. Once I'm done, everything will be fine.
:'''Leclerc:''' But you're interfering with its natural growth. It has its own way of adapting.
:'''Leclerc:''' We should guide these little ones based on their development, not just force changes on them.
:'''Adrian:'''It's more efficient if we handle the adjustments ourselves to improve their programming.
:'''Leclerc:''' Don't you think your approach is a bit too harsh? They hide from you every time they see you.
:'''Adrian:''' It's okay. I've got a remote controller to track them down.
:'''Leclerc:''' I... I just can't reason with you!
{{Dialogue End}}
